spots.name: Reserva de la Biosfera El Pinacate y Gran Desierto de Altar
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Quitobaquito Hills
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 480 m (1,575 ft).
